sources.supports: Documented one-way mixed HOV and ordinary lanes use motor_vehicle:lanes=no|yes|yes|yes and hov:lanes=designated|yes|yes|yes. Ordinary traffic is allowed in the yes columns;this does not make a designated HOV lane available to an ordinary car.
Lane vectors can include lanes for all vehicle types;the lanes count may count only motor traffic. Conditional syntax and directional variants need separate interpretation.
Mode lane permissions and turn/change attributes describe different properties. This prototype does not infer lane-to-lane maneuver feasibility.

inference: For a narrow coarse road-level model,a static one-way road with an explicit ordinary-car yes column need not be rejected in its entirety. This is an eligibility hypothesis,not proof of lane connectivity or causal detour repair. Existing road-level source turn rules stay. No timing ratio is derived from lane metadata.
prototypeScope: Only existing lane-access exclusions;canonical1..32 count,known nonempty nondirectional relevant access vectors with a common literal yes column,HOV yes at the same column when present. Every other base/conditional/access/oneway constraint remains. All old eligible policies are exact. Decline blank inheritance,two-way/directional/unknown/count-mismatch/conditional lane forms and restricted whole-way HOV. The common-column intersection is intentionally narrower than mode-precedence interpretation.
prohibitedUse: No way identity,name,city,coordinate,region,query or benchmark residual selects policy. Source identifiers appear only in output validation. No app/national/accuracy admission.
